description: The Indigenous Mining Agreements dataset from Natural Resources Canada gives information on the Indigenous communities that have signed agreements with mining companies, the types of agreements negotiated, and the exploration projects and producing mines they concern. Coverage is Canada, with a time period from 1970 and a yearly update frequency in the catalogue; the record was last modified on 12 January 2022. It is offered as an interactive Atlas of Canada map in English and French, OGC WMS and ESRI REST services, a file geodatabase and ArcMap project files, all free under the Open Government Licence - Canada, with NRCan pages on Indigenous participation in mining. Caveats: the record has not been modified since 2022 despite the yearly frequency, and agreement terms themselves are not included. For simulation it supplies the governance and social layer of mining projects, linking mines and projects to Indigenous communities for stakeholder, social licence and disruption risk analyses. Related catalogue records include Map 900A of principal mineral areas and producing mines, and ResourceContracts.
name: Indigenous Mining Agreements
